declarations.docstring: If the indicated map is surjective, the integer cast of the vertexwise natural number for the constructed object equals the finite-family transform of the vertexwise module finranks.
If the indicated map is injective, the integer cast of the vertexwise natural number for the constructed object equals the finite-family transform of the vertexwise module finranks.
Assigns a natural number to a vertex for an object over a commutative semiring.
Produces an integer at a vertex from a finite family of vertices, a distinguished vertex, and an integer-valued function on the vertex type.
